originalReview.reviewScope: Independent read-only parent review of W3 Qwen heap diagnostic: preparation/build/package/device/report routing and reviewed-freeze gating, prior to any new device run. Owned file: candidate/review.json. No implementation edits, no shell/build/device execution. Source lane QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt not in allowed context, so source-level label verification is out of scope (reported as limit).

findings.scenario: verify_frozen_contract() builds the `required` frozen-artifact set but omits 'probes/android-qwen-file/cases.json', which collected_evidence (context/verify_report.py:243) DOES require and evaluate consumes via module-level FROZEN_MANIFEST. A freeze can be generated and pass the device guard (no adb) without pinning the base manifest source.
findings.effect: Incomplete 'complete reviewed freeze': the device guard does not bind the manifest source that evaluate reads live. evaluate fails closed on mismatch (manifest==FROZEN_MANIFEST), so no false ACCEPT, but a reviewer cannot confirm at freeze time that the manifest equals the pinned base; freeze integrity is weaker than collected_evidence.
findings.recommendation: Add 'probes/android-qwen-file/cases.json' to the verify_frozen_contract required set (and ensure it is present in contract['files']) so the device guard and collected_evidence share one authoritative required-set.

findings.scenario: heap_evidence() enforces `8 <= len(events) <= 128`. The 7 named sampling points (initial, constructor-before, constructor-returned, core-persist, case-returned, recognizer-released, teardown) plus '每个corePersist' yield exactly 8 only if the instrumentation emits TWO core-persist samples. If QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt emits exactly ONE core-persist (7 boundary events), a structurally valid diagnostic is rejected (heapBoundaryEvidence=False), blocking a legitimate run.
findings.effect: Potential false rejection of a valid one-case run, or a silent unverified assumption (two core-persists) baked into the lower bound. The fixture/contract assume 8 events (2 core-persists, consistent with a two-stage case) but the exact count is a source-lane fact not in allowed context.
findings.recommendation: Confirm against QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt the exact core-persist count. If one, relax the lower bound to 7 (and keep core-persist>=1); otherwise document the two-core-persist requirement explicitly in spec/contract.

findings.scenario: heapBoundaryLabels mapping from logical keys to the ACTUAL Kotlin-emitted label strings is not verifiable: QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt is excluded from allowed context. Routing only enforces (a) 7 distinct non-empty strings, (b) each non-core boundary appears exactly once, (c) positional/ordering binding, and (d) last core-persist stages == report final stages. The contract's 7 distinct strings could be arbitrary; whether they equal emitted telemetry is unverified.
findings.effect: Cannot claim source-lane approval. Two failure modes: (1) if freeze labels != Kotlin emit, a valid run is rejected (fail-closed, no false ACCEPT); (2) source-lane correctness of the mapping itself is unconfirmed. No route accepts a report whose event labels don't match the contract, so the bound is safe against wrong ACCEPT but the mapping truth is open.
findings.recommendation: Include QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt in review context; pin and diff the exact emitted label strings against contract['heapBoundaryLabels']. Until then do not assert source-lane label correctness.

heapBoundaryLabels.reason: QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt not in allowed context; exact emitted strings unverifiable. Routing-enforced constraints only:

routingEnforced.initial: distinct non-empty string, exactly 1 event, earliest position
routingEnforced.core-persist: distinct non-empty string, >=1 event(s); last one must precede case-returned and its stages must equal report final stages
routingEnforced.case-returned: distinct non-empty string, exactly 1 event, after last core-persist
routingEnforced.teardown: distinct non-empty string, exactly 1 event, latest position

limitations: Source lane QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt excluded from allowed context: exact heap label strings, heapEvents emission count, and sticky-error behavior NOT verified from source (finding 3, and heapBoundaryLabels.unverifiedFromSource).
No device/RSS/native/allocator effects were executed or measured; all such claims are out of scope and not asserted.
Entire W3 completion not claimed; review covers parent routing/freeze/report gating only.

Gating inputs not hashed into the freeze contract but transitively pinned: host-result.json and base-hashes.json integrity is covered via candidate-accepted.json hostReceipt/baseHashesSHA256 (in frozen files); still, the device guard does not re-run verify_host, unlike build (acceptable: device depends on package/run-plan, not host receipt).

Two review flags + review artifacts ARE correctly bound: verify_frozen_contract requires independentSourceReviewAccepted/independentParentReviewAccepted True AND pins docs/validation/w3-qwen-heap-parent-review-20261111.json and wrapper-review in files; flags are read directly from the contract, so they cannot be bypassed by merely removing declared files. The review JSON verdict itself is not parsed (trusts the human flag), so a True flag with a changes-required file is not auto-detected.
QwenLoadCore real layout (probes/android-qwen-load) is correctly bound in prepare/build/device and tested by 19 routing tests; no layout bug found in reviewed code.

dispositions.change: Require probes/android-qwen-file/cases.json in verify_frozen_contract before any adb.
dispositions.red: Original guard reached mocked adb when the base manifest hash was omitted; test failed.
dispositions.green: All20 routing checks pass; omission fails before adb.

dispositions.evidence: QwenTwoStageCore.kt initial doPersist(snapshot(running)) at193 and final persist(built) at278, plus runOneStage dispatch snapshots; wrapper corePersist at327-342 captures each callback. Even empty-auto successful case has multiple core-persist events. Failed runs are not diagnosticAccepted.
dispositions.ruling: Keep8..128. A7-event accepted terminal report is not produced by the fixed core; no two-stage assumption is required.

dispositions.evidence: w3-qwen-heap-wrapper-review-20261111.json reviewed the exact wrapper SHA and all7 labels. Parent reviewer did not have source context and correctly declined that claim.
dispositions.ruling: Freeze the exact7-label map from the accepted source review; do not claim parent reviewer independently verified Kotlin.

scope: Parent freeze/routing/report acceptance only; original changes-required review is retained. Fix acceptance and cross-lane integration are primary judgments, not a second external review.
